title: Classic Doom micro-design vocabulary
purpose: Use this vocabulary when writing part_designs for new levels. Prefer concrete verbs and measurable contrasts over vague adjectives.
global_rules: Every major space gets its own part_design with NUMERIC light, NAMED textures, and aspect ratios.
Wall textures must change by zone (tech STAR*, brown BROWN*, slime SLAD*, stone GSTONE*, exit COMP*).
Shapes must vary: wide 2:1 halls, narrow 1:3 shafts, L hubs/arenas — not a chain of 256x256 squares.
Light hierarchy: start>=220, hub~150-170, maze<=80 (+flicker), key>=200, hazard~90-110, exit~190-210.
Height changes between rooms use kind=lift OR visible STEP risers — never an unmarked cliff.
Critical path should revisit at least one landmark (hub return).
One real gate (key/switch) beats three flavor doors.
Optional content must be skippable without soft-lock.
Warn before peaks: medkits/shells or a sightline into the arena.
Exit calmer/tighter than the peak fight.
Monster closets: closed door + walk tripwire in the fight space.
Cover is geometry (pillar/cover_block/dogleg), not only monster placement.

part_fields.shape: narrow, dogleg, L/U, wide hub, square arena, alcove, irregular organic, lattice junction
part_fields.elevation: floor/ceiling deltas vs neighbors; stairs; lifts; sunken pits; pedestals
part_fields.cover: pillar, cover_block, crates, dogleg corner, balcony, none (state why)
part_fields.mobs: who, where, vertical vs ground, closet timing
part_fields.triggers: door, locked door+color, walk closet, lift, switch, exit, secret use-wall
part_fields.textures: theme family (STAR tech, nukage, SKIN/flesh, outdoor sky)
part_fields.detail: one concrete sentence of player experience

contrast_pairs: optional maze vs mandatory hero walkway
see-through window tease vs later claim
wide peak arena vs tight exit coda
anti_patterns: All rooms share STARTAN2 / same flats / light~160
Vague elevation ('a bit lower') with no lift/STEP
Key in the same room as its door with no return
Arena with no cover and no vertical layer
Closet door with walk trigger on the impassable door face
Theme only in the title string, not in shapes/textures/light
